tools.name: vital_list_users
tools.description: List all Vital users in your team, paginated. Vital API: GET /v2/user.

tools.name: vital_get_user
tools.description: Get a single Vital user by their Vital user_id. Vital API: GET /v2/user/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_resolve_user
tools.description: Look up a Vital user by your own client_user_id (the stable id you assigned). Vital API: GET /v2/user/resolve/{client_user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_user_connected_providers
tools.description: List the wearables/data sources (providers) a user has connected. Vital API: GET /v2/user/providers/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_user_latest_info
tools.description: Get the latest device/app info reported for a user. Vital API: GET /v2/user/{user_id}/info/latest.

tools.name: vital_list_providers
tools.description: List all providers (wearables/data sources) Vital supports. Vital API: GET /v2/providers.

tools.name: vital_get_sleep
tools.description: Get sleep summaries for a user over a date range. Vital API: GET /v2/summary/sleep/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_activity
tools.description: Get activity summaries for a user over a date range. Vital API: GET /v2/summary/activity/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_workouts
tools.description: Get workouts summaries for a user over a date range. Vital API: GET /v2/summary/workouts/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_body
tools.description: Get body summaries for a user over a date range. Vital API: GET /v2/summary/body/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_meal
tools.description: Get meal summaries for a user over a date range. Vital API: GET /v2/summary/meal/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_menstrual_cycle
tools.description: Get menstrual cycle summaries for a user over a date range. Vital API: GET /v2/summary/menstrual_cycle/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_profile
tools.description: Get a user's profile summary (height, and other static attributes). Vital API: GET /v2/summary/profile/{user_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_timeseries
tools.description: Get timeseries data points for a user and resource over a date range. Supported resources: heartrate, hrv, glucose, blood_pressure, blood_oxygen, steps, respiratory_rate, body_weight, body_fat, distance, water, vo2_max, stress_level, mindfulness_minutes, calories_active, calories_basal, floors_climb

tools.name: vital_list_lab_tests
tools.description: List the lab tests available/configured for your team. Vital API: GET /v3/lab_tests.

tools.name: vital_get_lab_test
tools.description: Get a single lab test by id. Vital API: GET /v3/lab_tests/{lab_test_id}.

tools.name: vital_list_orders
tools.description: List lab-test orders with filters, paginated. Vital API: GET /v3/orders.

tools.name: vital_get_order
tools.description: Get a single lab-test order by id. Vital API: GET /v3/order/{order_id}.

tools.name: vital_get_order_results
tools.description: Get the lab-test results for an order. Vital API: GET /v3/order/{order_id}/result.

tools.name: vital_create_user
tools.description: Creates a Vital user record (additive). Returns the Vital user_id. Vital API: POST /v2/user.

tools.name: vital_create_link_token
tools.description: Creates a short-lived Link token to connect a user's wearable/provider (no health data is modified). Vital API: POST /v2/link/token.
